text:
Olivia Grant: Heads up everyone 1. The exec team is declaring a company-wide extra day off on 2026-09-03 to celebrate the product launch. This is a company-declared holiday.

Marta Lopez: Quick policy Q: Does this company-declared holiday automatically mean no PTO is consumed and no carryover usage? Also, how do contractors get handled (they're on different billing terms)?

Ravi Kumar: Payroll note: company-declared holidays do not deduct PTO for employees on salaried contracts. However, contractors and certain hourly temps are handled per contract: some contracts bill for the day, some expect holiday rates. Contractor Billing Bot will list affected vendors.

Contractor Billing Bot: Found 12 active contractors with `holiday_paid=true` in their contracts, 4 with `holiday_paid=false`. I'll emit a vendor payload and notify their managers.

Ankit Mehra: For employees with 0 PTO balance or with carryover preference, will the system forcibly use carryover? I want to preserve carryover for planned leaves in Q4.

Marta Lopez: Policy decision: For company-declared holidays that cover the full shift, we will not consume PTO or carryover by default. No forced carryover usage. If an employee explicitly requests to use PTO (e.g., to convert to a floating holiday for a different date), manager can approve and payroll will tag it. We'll add UI copy: "Company-declared holidays do not consume PTO. To use PTO instead, select 'consume PTO' and get manager signoff."

Ravi Kumar: Payroll will expect a payload like:

employee: ankit.mehra
date: 2026-09-03
holiday_type: company_declared
pto_deduction: false
payroll_tag: company_holiday
contractor_handled: false

If an employee opts to consume PTO, payroll_tag becomes `pto_chosen_by_employee` and manager approval must be attached.

Marta Lopez: One catch: performance calibration blackout runs 2026-08-30..2026-09-05. During blackout we try to avoid changes to payroll and benefits. Does this block any retroactive changes or encashments related to this holiday?

Ravi Kumar: Blackout applies to salary/payout changes, not passive holiday observance. So the day off stands and payroll will mark it as `company_holiday` automatically. Encashment requests or PTO-to-cash elections referencing that day would be queued until blackout ends unless marked `urgent_payroll_action` with manager+people-ops approval.

Ankit Mehra: What about employees in offices that already had a regional holiday on 2026-09-03? Do we double-count?

Marta Lopez: We'll de-duplicate: if regional statutory holiday exists, we'll still show a single holiday event; PTO won't be deducted. Payroll must check `regional_holiday` and not double-apply. people-ops-bot will run a pre-check when someone files a request.

people-ops-bot: Auto-check: 2026-09-03: global company_declared_holiday + regional overlaps found for offices: CA: no, UK: no, IN: Ganesh Chaturthi (regional) flagged for parts of IN. Action: show merged event and set `pto_deduction=false` for affected employees.

Ankit Mehra: Contractor detail again: if a contractor has `holiday_paid=false` but wants to take the day unpaid and shift hours, can they bill different days later?

Contractor Billing Bot: Contractual guidance: billable shifts are per contract. If `holiday_paid=false`, the contractor can request to reschedule deliverables; managers must approve extra billable days. Billing adjustments require a PO amendment for outside-of-scope changes.

Marta Lopez: Operational items: 1) People Ops will update the PTO request UI copy and add a short FAQ entry, 2) Payroll will add `company_holiday` tag and regional de-dup logic, 3) Contractor Billing Bot will notify managers of contractors with `holiday_paid=false`.

Ravi Kumar: I'll post the payroll payload schema to the HR API and ensure blackout rules queue non-essential payroll changes. For audit, payroll will add `holiday_declaration_id` and `approver=exec_team` fields.

Marta Lopez: I'll draft the FAQ and send a notice to managers about contractor handling and the blackout. Also adding an example Slack command for employees who want to voluntarily consume PTO: `@people-ops-bot request-pto --date 2026-09-03 --consume_holiday=true --manager=@your_manager`. Manager approval required.

Olivia Grant: Thanks all 1. Appreciate the quick coordination. Everyone enjoy the day 973

people-ops-bot: Reminder: People Ops will publish FAQ & UI update by 2026-08-28 17:00. Calendar invite for manager guidance session sent.
